effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [Chronicle] trait, gain 1 memory. [On Play] Activate 1 of the effects below: ・Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [X Antibody] or [Chronicle] trait card among them to the hand. Trash the rest. ・You may play 1 level 3 [Chronicle] trait Digimon card from your hand to your breeding area without paying the cost.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
